05风险闭环 · 未来 3—5 年愿景RISK MANAGEMENT · THREE-TO-FIVE-YEAR VISION

让代表处自主履行维护责任Help each office own its maintenance risks

责任在一线，风险早化解，让客户网络更稳定、服务更有韧性。Frontline teams resolve risks early to keep customer networks stable and services resilient.

机关专业支撑Headquarters support

统一标准与升级机制Set standards and escalation rules

组织专家支撑重大问题Bring in experts for major issues

自主闭环Local risk closure

主动发现风险 → 自主研判 → 及时处置 → 复盘改进Detect risks → assess impact → act → review outcomes

协同履责Shared response

一线主责，按风险分级响应；专家会诊，重大事项升级。Local owners lead. Specialists join as needed. Major issues escalate.

运营洞察Operational insight

跟踪风险态势与整改进度，结合服务质量、经营价值和人员能力研判影响。Track risk trends and corrective action. Assess the impact on service, business and staff.

可信基础Trusted evidence

事实可见、标准一致、责任到人、证据可溯。Use shared facts, consistent standards, named owners and traceable evidence.

地区部协同统筹Regional coordination

统筹资源与跨国协作Coordinate resources across countries

监督重点风险及整改进展Oversee priority risks and corrective action

人承担维护责任，数据、平台与 AI 为一线判断提供支撑。People own the outcome. Data, the platform and AI support frontline decisions.

近期 · 看得清Near term · Visibility打通事实，明确每项风险的责任人Connect the evidence and name a risk owner

关键动作之前，人始终在环。A human stays in the loop for anything that matters.

  • 审批卡Approval cards写入、删除、真实发送前，先给人看“发什么、发给谁”See what and to whom before writes, deletes or sends
  • 敏感信息脱敏Secrets masked密码、Token、Cookie 不发给模型Passwords, tokens, cookies never reach the model
  • 团队隔离Team isolation一个账号 = 一个团队数据空间，互不可见One account = one team space, isolated
  • 写前备份、可撤销Backup & undo改动可回退；历史口径不被悄悄重算Changes reversible; history never silently recomputed
12三个转变THREE SHIFTS

不只是一个工具，是工作方式的转变Not just a tool — a new way of working

01
人找系统People chase systems↓系统找人Systems find people

过去靠人记得去看；现在问题自己找上门，人只负责处理。We used to remember to look; now problems come to us.

02
个人工具Personal tools↓组织能力Team capability

一个人的经验写成 Skill、一次好对话分享出去，就成了团队能复用、会变好的能力。Know-how written as a Skill, a good chat shared — it becomes reusable, improving team capability.

03
操作员Operator↓决策者与教练Decision-maker & coach

人不再搬数据，而是定标准、做判断，并教 Agent 做得更好。People set standards, make the call — and coach the agent to do better.

思考 ②如果系统已经能自己发现问题，我们最该把时间花在哪里？Idea ②If systems can find problems by themselves, where should we spend our time?

13跨区域推广 · 团队估算CROSS-REGION ROLLOUT · TEAM ESTIMATE

推广到其他代表处，已有 7 分可复用Rolling out to other offices: 7 of 10 points ready

7

现有平台已实现Ready to reuse

从采集数据、识别风险，到通知责任人、跟踪整改和复盘，已有一套可复用的流程。Teams can reuse the workflow for collecting data, identifying risks, notifying owners and verifying corrective action.

1

代表处继续开发Local development

当地团队按自己的数据源、风险规则和责任分工，定制采集脚本与提醒流程。Local teams adapt collection scripts and alerts to their data sources, risk rules and owners.

2

机关数字人 2.0 基座Digital Human 2.0 at headquarters

接入基座后，可按统一口径更快取数，让一线更及时地看到风险变化。A shared data standard and faster retrieval could help offices see changes in risk sooner.

这 2 分有一个前提：源数据准确，实时更新才有助于判断风险。Those last two points depend on accurate source data. Timely updates are only useful when teams can trust them.
